name: duel-perfect-aim
description: G5/D1: cart plays his recording into the Apartments, stops at 18.0 s (0.5 s before his recorded first shot), aims at Lokier's head and fires, every shot on target from the first. D1 (John 2026-11-07 13:10): his shots do real damage inside the recorded duel too, so his first shot (18.05 s), a headshot, kills Lokier at once, before Lokier's recorded hit (18.50 s) can land; inside the drift window the rest of the round stays on script. Then he plays his recording again to the end.
